key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Erect perennial milkweed of wet ground, stream margins, and other moist sites.

key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Leaves narrow and elongate, giving the plant a noticeably slender-leaved look.

key_traits.label: Look here first
key_traits.text: Start with the wet-site habitat, erect habit, narrow opposite leaves, and rounded pink flower umbels.
